main_text.p: dicitur. In ea autem pro primo proportionis termino, totum ex additis differentijs: pro secundo, totum e mensurarum numeris: pro reliquarum rationum terminis antecedentibus, alternatas extremorum a medio differentias, sumimus.
1. Hospes duplex unum habet: alterum pretij 6, alterum pretij 12. Ex his 6 cantharos pretij 10 haurire constituit: quot igitur cantharos e singulis generibus hauriet?
Hic totus e mensurarum simplicium numeris datus est 6. Itaq; alternatis differentijs ut uides:
Totum e differentijs sex, pro primo termino: pro secundo 6, & pro reliquarum rationum antecedentibus terminis 2 & 4 sumo: tumq; compositam proportionem facio sic:

Itaq; hic duo canthari pretij 6, & 4 canthari pretij 12 hauriendi erūt. Hinc apparet, si totus e numeris mensurarum simplicium, toti e numeris differentiarum aequalis sit, numeros differentiarum esse numeros mensurarum simplicium.

page.notes: Right-page fragments at the right edge are cut off and illegible; the running head and page number are printed at the top. Some words in the diagrams are uncertain and the Latin fragments of the right page were not transcribed.
